title: NASA+ Content Coming to Big Screen at Greenbelt, Maryland Cinema
text: NASA announced Monday that NASA+ content has found its first theatrical home at The Greenbelt Cinema in Greenbelt, Maryland, expanding the agency’s reach across major viewing platforms and bringing space even closer to home. “The National Aeronautics and Space Act of 1958 calls us to share our story of space exploration with the broadest possible […]

zhTitle: NASA+ 內容即將在馬里蘭州格林貝爾特影院大銀幕上映
zh: 美國國家航空暨太空總署（NASA）週一宣布，NASA+ 的內容已在馬里蘭州格林貝爾特的格林貝爾特電影院首次登上大銀幕，擴大了該機構在主要觀看平台的影響力，並讓太空更加貼近人們的生活。“1958 年的《國家航空與太空法》要求我們與最廣泛的觀眾分享太空探索的故事[…]
